description: Dev conventions hooks. PreToolUse blocks the convention violations that can be detected mechanically (pip in a uv project, npm in a bun project, hand-editing a lockfile), each gated on positive evidence from the project itself. SessionStart injects only what cannot be enforced. The `if` filters are spawn optimisations; every decision is made in-script from the parsed tool_input, because `if` fails open on unparseable Bash.
